entities.name: Nicolás Redondo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nicolás Redondo Urbieta was a Spanish trade unionist and politician. A member of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party, he served as secretary-general of the Unión General de Trabajadores from 1976 to 1994 and was a deputy from 1977 to 1987.
